'''Darth Spam Big Bad Four''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Spam]]
* '''Published:''' 3 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: City Outskirts|Tat-L-tatooinecityoutskirts.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: City Outskirts
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Tatooine City Outskirts Spam LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A deck that revolves around battling with Luke, Leia, Han, and Chewie, AKA the Big Bad Four.

== Strategy ==

This deck revolves around the distribution of massive beat-downs to your opponent. If Han, Chewie, Leia, and Luke (the Big Bad Four) all at the same site with I’m With You Too on Luke, this deck is unstoppable. To put things in perspective, if the above condition is fulfilled, and Obi-Wan is at the same site, I could draw 17 battle destiny, add two to each, then double it. If I drew a location for each destiny, (which would never happen anyway; I only have 5 locations in my deck) my opponent would have to forfeit for 68.

Needless to say, that’s a lot of cards to get, and that is precisely the reason I have 3 Control/ Tunnel Visions. And if case my opponent gets smart and loads his deck with Ghhhk’s, I can trash them all with Grimtaash. Binks is used mainly as an anti-Guri weapon so I can keep drawing battle destiny. However, it is not uncommon for my opponent to just not battle me at all, which is why I have a good supply of sticks (for drains), Order to Engage (to counteract the "run away!" strategy), and the cantina, as it gives me a pretty good drain.

The last problem is that of Force activation, which I am still working on, but I put in Tosche Station and a lot of other locations to help minimize that dilemma.

One last thing: PLEASE RATE THIS DECK!!!!
